εφφαθα.as:
† ἐφφαθά
(Aram. אֶתְפְּתח, v. Abbott, Essays, 142 ff.; DCG, i, 522)
ephphatha, be opened: Mk 7:34.†

ἐφημερία.long: a class of priests who served for a stated number of days.
ἐφημερία.sd: diurnality, i.e. (specially) the quotidian rotation or class of the Jewish priests' service at the Temple, as distributed by families
ἐφημερία.as:
† ἐφ-ημερία, -ας, ἡ
(< ἐφήμερος), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁמֶרֶת, מַחֲלֹקֶת ;]
1.a course of daily services (Ne 13:30, I Ch 25:8, al.).
2.a class or course of priests detailed for service in the temple (I Ch 23:6, al.): Lk 1:5, 8 (cf. MGr., ἐφημέριος, priest).†

ἐφοράω.der: and other moods and persons of the same tense; from G1909 (ἐπί) and G1492 (εἴδω);
ἐφοράω.as:
* ἐπ-εῖδον 2 aor. without pres. in use;
[in LXX chiefly for רָאָה ;] to regard with attention, look upon (in cl., of the gods)
1. with a view to bless: c. inf., Lk 1:25 (cf. DB, 136 b).
2. To punish: seq. ἐπί, Ac 4:29.†

ἐφίστημι.g: I stand by, am urgent, befall one, impend
ἐφίστημι.long: I stand by, am urgent, befall one (as of evil), am at hand, impend.
ἐφίστημι.sd: to stand upon, i.e. be present (in various applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literal);
ἐφίστημι.kj: --assault, come (in, to, unto, upon), be at hand (instant), present, stand (before, by, over)
ἐφίστημι.as:
ἐφ-ίστημι
[in LXX for נָצַב ni., שִׁית, נָתַן, etc. ;]
1. causal in pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to set upon or by, set up, etc. (Æsch., Hdt., Arist., al).
2. Intrans. in mid, and in pf. and 2 aor. act.;
(a)to stand upon;
(b)to be set over;
(c)to stand by, be present, be at hand, come on or upon: Lk 2:3810:4020:1, Ac 6:1212:722:13, 2023:27, II Ti 4:2; c. dat. pers., Lk 2:924:4, Ac 4:123:11; c. dat. loc., Ac 17:5; seq. έπί, c. acc, Ac 10:1711:11; of rain, Ac 28:2; of evils impending, c. dat. pers., I Th 5:3; seq. έπί (Wi 6:9), Lk 21:34; of time, II Ti 4:6 (cf. κατ-, συν-εφίστημι).†

Ἐφραίμ.der: of Hebrew origin (H0669 or better H06085);
Ἐφραίμ.as:
Ἐφραίμ, (-ΐμ, Tr.)
Ephraim, a town near Jerusalem: Jo 11:54.†

Ἔφεσος.long: Ephesus, a coast city, capital of the Roman province Asia.
Ἔφεσος.sd: Ephesus, a city of Asia Minor
Ἔφεσος.as:
Ἔφεσος, -ου, ἡ
Ephesus, a city in Asia Minor Ac 18:19, 21, 24, 2719:1, 17, 26 (on the gen., v. M, Pr., 73) Ac 20:16, 17, I Co 15:3216:8, Eph 1:1, I Ti 1:3, II Ti 1:184:12, Re 1:112:1.†

ἐφάλλομαι.as:
ἐφάλλομαι
[in LXX for צָלַח, I Ki 10:611:616:13 * ;]
to leap upon: seq. ἐπί c. acc pers. Ac 19:16.†

Ἐφέσιος.sd: an Ephesian or inhabitant of Ephesus
Ἐφέσιος.as:
Ἐφέσιος, -α, -ον
Ephesian: Ac 18:2719:28, 34, 3521:29.†

ἐφευρετής.der: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G2147 (εὑρίσκω);
ἐφευρετής.as:
* ἐφ-ευρετής, -οῦ, ὁ
(< ἐφευρίσκω, to find out)
an inventor, contriver: κακῶν (cf. κακίαςεὑρετής, II Mac 7:31), Ro 1:30.†

ἐφάπαξ.long: once, once for all; at once.
ἐφάπαξ.as:
* ἐφ-άπαξ,
adv.
1.once for all (Eupol.): Ro 6:10He 7:279:1210:10.
2.at once: I Co 15:6.†

ἐφικνέομαι.g: I come to, reach as far as
ἐφικνέομαι.long: I come to, reach as far as.
ἐφικνέομαι.sd: to arrive upon, i.e. extend to
ἐφικνέομαι.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a cognate of G2240 (ἥκω);
ἐφικνέομαι.as:
** ἐφ-ικνέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX: Si 43:27, 30 R (ἀφικ- ABא)* ;]
to come to, to reach: seq. ἄχρι, II Co 10:13; εἰς, ib. 14.†

ἐφήμερος.long: for the day, daily, necessary for every day.
ἐφήμερος.as:
* ἐφ-ήμερος, -ον
(ἐπί, ἡμέρα),
1.lasting for a day.
2.daily, for the day: Ja 2:15.†
